end.summary:
Read and wrote a 4-digit number in words with prompting.
Practised place value using thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones.
Added digits instead of using their place values in one attempt.
Left out zero when an empty place was represented.
Place-value chart activity was not completed; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Diya practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers and representing them by place value. They read “one thousand two hundred forty-eight” after an initial attempt in Hindi, and engaged with the tens-and-ones examples. Diya mixed up place value by adding digits or treating a digit as its face value, and these mix-ups were not corrected after the last time they appeared. At home, use a place-value chart with counters or drawings, including an empty place such as 4,050, and ask Diya to say what each digit is worth.
